_comment: Spike 007 · committed per-solution SKELETON. BINDINGS-DRIVEN design: ConnectionReferences are built by gen-deployment-settings.sh from the app's client_payload.bindings (the running app is the source of truth for which refs exist and their per-env ConnectionId + ConnectorId) — NOT from this file. ConnectionReferences here is therefore empty and unused. EnvironmentVariables (19-09, OI-1 option A / D-23): this skeleton DECLARES the solution's environment-variable SchemaNames ONLY — entries of shape { "SchemaName": "oss_..." }, NO values. Per-target VALUES live in config/env-vars.<envkey>.json (a maintained, PR-reviewed config — never copied from the source env), jq-merged by SchemaName in gen-deployment-settings.sh, which fails loudly if any declared SchemaName lacks a target value. Secret-type / Key Vault vars carry the @Microsoft.KeyVault(SecretUri=...) REFERENCE only — the raw secret never enters git or the payload. T8Probe declares none, so the array is empty. EnvironmentVariables are separate from GitHub Actions variables.
